CCP_toggle_diplo_rules = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ccp_diplo_rules = 1 }
		}
		set_variable = { ccp_diplo_rules = 0 }
		set_rule = {
			can_create_factions = no
			can_join_factions = no
			can_declare_war_on_same_ideology = no
			can_guarantee_other_ideologies = no
			can_puppet = no
			can_send_volunteers = no
			can_boost_other_ideologies = no
			can_access_market = no
			can_create_collaboration_government = no
		}
		set_variable = { global.ccp_status = 19 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { ccp_diplo_rules = 1 }
		set_rule = {
			can_create_factions = yes
			can_join_factions = yes
			can_declare_war_on_same_ideology = yes
			can_guarantee_other_ideologies = yes
			can_puppet = yes
			can_send_volunteers = yes
			can_boost_other_ideologies = yes
			can_access_market = yes
			can_create_collaboration_government = yes
		}
		set_variable = { global.ccp_status = 18 }
	}
	CCP_mark_dirty = yes
}

CCP_toggle_ai_goodwill = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ccp_ai_goodwill = 1 }
		}
		set_variable = { ccp_ai_goodwill = 0 }
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { tag = ROOT }
			}
			remove_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = ccp_goodwill }
		}
		set_variable = { global.ccp_status = 21 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { ccp_ai_goodwill = 1 }
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { tag = ROOT }
			}
			add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = ccp_goodwill }
			add_ai_strategy = { type = befriend id = ROOT value = 200 }
		}
		set_variable = { global.ccp_status = 20 }
	}
	CCP_mark_dirty = yes
}

CCP_toggle_confirmations = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { global.ccp_confirm_destructive = 1 }
		}
		set_variable = { global.ccp_confirm_destructive = 0 }
		set_variable = { global.ccp_status = 3 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { global.ccp_confirm_destructive = 1 }
		set_variable = { global.ccp_status = 2 }
	}
	CCP_mark_dirty = yes
}
